attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. **The whole of the page's text is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Ρώσου Αγίου.»** That is a refusal to tell the life and not a refusal to vouch for the man: no asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου…». The only year is in the head and it is recorded. **`types` is empty: the page gives him no rank at all beyond «Άγιος», and no slug in this corpus's vocabulary is supported by the line.** Its related links name the synaxis of all the saints of Siberia and OCA's Feasts and Saints, neither of which was read. It names Abalatsk and no coordinate is proposed; it prints no hymn. The `russian` row is left `undocumented` although the page calls him a Russian saint, because days.pravoslavie.ru was not read. **The same day page also keeps «Άγιος Μισαήλ (άγιοι Τρεις Παίδες)», one of the Three Youths, whom the corpus keeps as `misael-of-the-three-youths`; two entries on one calendar day are two commemorations, and a Babylonian youth and an eighteenth-century Siberian are plainly not one man.**
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
